content:
Constellation Brands (STZ) stock is priced at 11.6 times earnings over the past twelve months, as reported, against 22.9 for the S&P 500. Shareholders paying that price need to know what they are buying, and management has changed what it talks about. On its fiscal Q2 2026 call in October 2025, management emphasized that most consumers it surveyed, Hispanic and non-Hispanic alike, were worried about the economy. Now the company emphasizes something different. So what is it?

Constellation Brands Now Talks Up Its Own Marketing

On the fiscal Q2 2027 call on October 7, 2026, management said its increased investments and focus on marketing are working. Constellation was also the biggest gainer of dollar share in beverage alcohol that quarter, management said.

That is a different case from the one management made a year earlier. On the fiscal Q2 2026 call, management said 80% of the Hispanic and non-Hispanic consumers it surveys continue to express concern about the socioeconomic environment. On the fiscal Q3 2026 call in January 2026, management said the beer category remained challenged, and that this was largely around the Hispanic consumer. Constellation has shifted its focus from a worry about its customers, a factor largely outside its control, to the money it is spending itself.

How Big Is Beer, And Is It Growing?

The beer business is nearly the whole company , which is why the worry about its customers mattered. The segment had revenue of $8.32 billion in fiscal 2026, accounting for 91.0% of company revenue. Those sales fell 2.6% from a year earlier, after rising 4.6% in fiscal 2025.

Company revenue has since turned up, rising 6.1% from a year earlier to $2.63 billion in fiscal Q2 2027, after a 3.3% fall in fiscal Q1 2027. Within beer, management said Pacifico, now a top 10 beer brand, is growing at something like 20%.

Management is also spending more on marketing, and said the company had probably underspent on it over the last couple of years. The company expects marketing to be about 10% of net sales in the second half of fiscal 2027, and above 11% in fiscal Q3 2027 as it spends on Major League Baseball and NCAA football.

Is Constellation Brands’ Turn To Marketing Reassuring For Holders?

On balance, the change is reassuring. Management now talks about what the company is doing rather than what its customers fear, and sales have started to grow again. Alongside the extra marketing, Constellation expects beer operating margins of 34.5% to 35.5% in the second half of fiscal 2027. Management also said September depletions, or beer sold by distributors to retailers, were trending in the right direction. If those trends continue, the company expects comparable earnings per share, its own adjusted measure, at the high end of its fiscal 2027 range of $11.20 to $11.90.

Yet the evidence so far is one quarter, and part of it came from restocking. Management said the company spent much of the first half rebuilding distributor inventory levels, and needed to ship during the quarter to close out distributor order backlogs. Over the twelve months to August 2026, revenue was still down 4.3% from a year earlier. The rest of the company, wine and spirits, saw its sales fall 50.6% in fiscal 2026, after Constellation sold part of that business.

The economy has not left the picture either. Pricing net of mix was roughly flat in fiscal Q2 2027, and management said it had been selective with its pricing actions given the macroeconomic backdrop. Revenue growth against a year earlier, 6.1% in fiscal Q2 2027, is the number to watch when Constellation Brands reports on or around January 5, 2027.

chineseTitle: 星座品牌股票是否已成为不同的赌注？
chineseSummary: 据报道，Constellation Brands (STZ) 股票在过去 12 个月的市盈率是 11.6 倍，而标准普尔 500 指数的市盈率为 22.9 倍。支付这个价格的股东需要知道他们在购买什么，而管理层已经改变了它所谈论的内容。在 2025 年 10 月召开的 2026 年第二季度财报电话会议上，管理层强调，接受调查的大多数消费者（无论是西班牙裔还是非西班牙裔）都对经济感到担忧。现在该公司强调一些不同的东西。那么它是什么。
chineseContent:
据报道，Constellation Brands (STZ) 股票在过去 12 个月的市盈率是 11.6 倍，而标准普尔 500 指数的市盈率为 22.9 倍。支付这个价格的股东需要知道他们在购买什么，而管理层已经改变了它所谈论的内容。在 2025 年 10 月召开的 2026 年第二季度财报电话会议上，管理层强调，接受调查的大多数消费者（无论是西班牙裔还是非西班牙裔）都对经济感到担忧。现在该公司强调一些不同的东西。那么它是什么？

星座品牌现在开始谈论自己的营销

在 2026 年 10 月 7 日召开的 2027 年第二季度财报电话会议上，管理层表示，增加投资和注重营销正在发挥作用。管理层表示，星座公司也是该季度酒精饮料中美元份额涨幅最大的公司。

这与一年前管理层提出的情况不同。在 2026 年第二财季电话会议上，管理层表示，在其调查的西班牙裔和非西班牙裔消费者中，80% 的消费者继续对社会经济环境表示担忧。在 2026 年 1 月召开的 2026 年第三季度财报电话会议上，管理层表示，啤酒类别仍然面临挑战，而且这主要针对西班牙裔消费者。星座公司已将其关注重点从对客户的担忧（这一因素很大程度上超出了其控制范围）转移到了自己的支出上。

啤酒有多大，还在增长吗？

啤酒业务几乎占据了整个公司，这就是为什么对客户的担忧如此重要。该部门2026财年营收为83.2亿美元，占公司营收的91.0%。继 2025 财年增长 4.6% 后，这些销售额同比下降 2.6%。

此后，公司收入开始回升，在 2027 年第一财季下降 3.3% 后，2027 年第二财季同比增长 6.1%，达到 26.3 亿美元。在啤酒领域，管理层表示，目前排名前 10 的啤酒品牌 Pacifico 的增长率约为 20%。

管理层还在营销方面投入了更多资金，并表示公司过去几年在营销方面的支出可能不足。该公司预计，2027 财年下半年营销费用将占净销售额的 10% 左右，2027 财年第三季度，由于其在美国职业棒球大联盟和 NCAA 橄榄球方面的支出，营销费用将占净销售额的 11% 以上。

星座品牌转向营销能让持有者放心吗？

总的来说，这种变化令人欣慰。管理层现在谈论的是公司正在做的事情，而不是客户担心的事情，销售额也开始再次增长。除了额外的营销之外，Constellation 预计 2027 财年下半年的啤酒营业利润率为 34.5% 至 35.5%。管理层还表示，9 月份的啤酒耗尽，即分销商向零售商出售的啤酒，正朝着正确的方向发展。如果这些趋势持续下去，该公司预计每股收益（其调整后的指标）将达到 2027 财年区间的上限，即 11.20 美元至 11.90 美元。

但迄今为止的证据只有四分之一，其中一部分来自补货。管理层表示，该公司上半年大部分时间都在重建分销商库存水平，并需要在本季度发货以结束分销商积压订单。截至 2026 年 8 月的 12 个月内，收入仍较去年同期下降 4.3%。在 Constellation 出售部分业务后，该公司的其他业务（葡萄酒和烈酒）的销售额在 2026 财年下降了 50.6%。

经济也没有消失。 2027 财年第二季度的混合定价大致持平，管理层表示，考虑到宏观经济背景，其定价行动是有选择性的。 Constellation Brands 在 2027 年 1 月 5 日左右发布报告时值得关注的数字是 2027 年第二财季的收入同比增长 6.1%。
